[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Wearable fitness tracker: A tracker monitoring heart rate, steps, and calories burned, integrating with other fitness apps.

[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 9. Smart hydration bottle: A bottle tracking water intake and providing reminders, integrating with fitness apps.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 10. Virtual reality fitness experience: An immersive VR experience for exercise in various environments, with virtual trainers and customizable workouts.
